name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Mason and Potter, one goes with Edmund and the other with 10 coins.
If Edmund does not go with Tanner, then 10 coins goes with Rowan.
Either Potter goes with 10 coins or Tanner goes with 8 coins.
Exactly one of these is true: Edmund goes with 10 coins; Rowan goes with 8 coins; Mason goes with 10 coins.

hints.text: Suppose Edmund went with Tanner — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Edmund goes with Tanner.
Edmund goes with Tanner, so it can't also go with Mason.
Edmund goes with Tanner, so it can't also go with Potter.
Tanner goes with Edmund, so Matilda can't go with Tanner.
Tanner goes with Edmund, so Rowan can't go with Tanner.
The clues force Mason to go with 10 coins.
The clues force Potter to go with 10 coins.
…but now the clue “Between Mason and Potter, one goes with Edmund and the other with 10 coins” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Edmund does not go with Tanner.
